base: vintage 19th-century storybook pen-and-ink engraving, black and white line art, fine cross-hatching and stippling, etching illustration, clean off-white background, light airy line art, mostly white, pure line art (NOT watercolor, no grey wash, NOT dark). WIDE HORIZONTAL LANDSCAPE orientation, 3:2 aspect ratio, much wider than tall. RECURRING CHARACTER A (must look identical in every image): a lean weathered working MAN in his fifties, short beard, plain 19th-century rural work clothes - collarless linen shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, dark waistcoat, worn trousers, leather boots, a wide-brimmed felt hat. He is a working man, NOT a gentleman: no top hat, no frock coat, no tie. RECURRING CHARACTER B (must look identical in every image): a sturdy dark working HORSE, muscular, plain leather halter and a long thick lead rope, NO saddle, NO rider. RECURRING SETTING: a wide calm river with a shallow gravel and sand bank, tall reeds, a few old twisted trees and low hills on the far side; a dirt path comes down to the water. Realistic proportions between man and horse. No other people, no crowd. Whimsical, elegant, highly detailed, classic fairytale book plate. NO text, NO words, NO letters, NO signage, NO numbers, NO logos, NO lettering anywhere, no color.

images.scene: TOP-DOWN ZENITAL VIEW looking STRAIGHT DOWN from directly overhead, camera pointing vertically at the ground, bird's eye. NO horizon and NO sky anywhere in the frame, only the ground and the water seen from above. On the left the man stands ANKLE-DEEP IN THE SHALLOW RIVER WATER seen from straight above - only the crown of his hat, his shoulders and his boots, with ripples spreading around him; directly OPPOSITE him on the dry sand the horse is planted, also seen from straight above - its back, mane and four hooves dug in. The taut rope is a straight line between them crossing the waterline, and long curved drag marks are scraped in the wet sand around the horse's hooves.

images.name: img-10a
images.scene: STRICT SIDE PROFILE CLOSE-UP of the MAN's head and shoulders, his face turned to face the RIGHT edge of the frame, seen purely from the side, nose and chin in silhouette against the background. He is straining with everything he has: HEAVILY SWEATING - large distinct beads and rivulets of sweat clearly drawn running down his temple, cheek and jaw, several droplets hanging off his chin and flying off, his hair soaked and plastered to his forehead under the hat brim, his shirt collar damp, jaw set hard, brow furrowed. His expression is DETERMINED, firm and unbroken - he is NOT screaming, NOT grimacing, NOT in pain. His visible eye is wide open and locked forward, staring intently into the eyes of something just beyond the right edge of the frame. Plain pale empty background, nothing else in the frame.

images.name: img-10b
images.scene: STRICT SIDE PROFILE CLOSE-UP of the HORSE's head and upper neck, its head turned to face the LEFT edge of the frame, seen purely from the side, muzzle and jawline in silhouette. It is straining with everything it has: SWEAT glistening and running down its neck and cheek, nostrils flared, neck muscles taut and standing out, plain leather halter on its head. Its expression is DETERMINED and firm, calm and unbroken - NOT panicked, NOT terrified, ears upright and forward rather than pinned back. Its visible eye is wide open and locked forward, staring intently into the eyes of something just beyond the left edge of the frame. Plain pale empty background, nothing else in the frame.
